text:
alex: quick question — we have a hot rollback queued for the 2–3pm change window, who is allowed to actually press the prod deploy button if we need to revert?
ops-bot: Reminder: deploys require a holder of the `deployer` role + MFA unless an emergency breakglass flow is initiated. See #oncall-procedures.
alex: i know, but this is last-minute. can we pre-authorize someone? i don't want delays if rollback becomes necessary. :grimacing:
maria: we can pre-grant a short-lived session to a named engineer — but per policy it needs two approvers (sre + eng manager) and an audit entry. i'd prefer we pin the rollback commit so the deploy is deterministic.
sam: +1 on pinning. command we use is basically: `deploy-bot claim --who sam --reason "rollback prep" --expires 60m` then `deploy-bot run --pin sha:ab12cd34 --env prod --strategy immediate`
jin: if we grant a session, make sure KV token rotation is recorded. i don't want stale creds. also, add `--no-cache` flag to the rollback run so we avoid hitting old cached artifacts by accident.
alex: who can sign off as second approver? @sre_lead?
sre_lead: i can approve provided we follow the checklist: 1) pin commit hash 2) create a runbook entry in opswiki 3) two-factor claim is used (even breakglass requires MFA on claiming) 4) post a post-deploy verification snippet in this thread. i'll approve now if steps are done.
maria: i've created the runbook stub: https://wiki.internal/ops/rollbacks/328765 — please add verification steps.
release-bot: CI: production candidates verified — smoke tests: passed (3/3). Canary baseline healthy.
alex: ok i will pin the commit and request the claim. executing: `deploy-bot claim --who alex --reason "standby rollback prep" --expires 45m`
ops-bot: Claim created by alex. Approvers required: 1) sre_lead 2) engineering_manager. Use `deploy-bot approve --by <approver>` to complete.
sam: engineering_manager is OOO today until 4pm. we need explicit approval path — can @maria act as acting manager for this window?
maria: i can act as acting manager for this window and approve once i see the pinned commit and runbook filled. :white_check_mark:
jin: once approved, we should also pin the deploy-bot to `--no-rollback-on-failure` off (i.e., allow rollback) so automated safety checks still run. log snippet for reference: ```yaml
deploy:
  pin: "ab12cd34"
  env: prod
  strategy: immediate
  allow_auto_rollback: true
  flags: ["no-cache"]
```
sre_lead: approved. maria approved as acting manager. alex — you are cleared to perform claim and run. ensure slack post includes verification steps (endpoint smoke, metrics delta, error-rate threshold).
alex: claim + approved, running the rollback in 2 mins. will post verification in this thread. :rocket:
release-bot: deploy started by alex (deploy-bot run id: db-9078). streaming logs: https://logs.internal/db-9078
alex: deploy completed, rollback applied to v1.4.3 (sha ab12cd34). basic smoke checks: auth/login OK, embeddings endpoint seeing normal latency (<120ms), error-rate unchanged.
jin: checking KV token rotation — rotated and recorded. audit id: audit-5521.
sre_lead: good. leaving a note for postmortem if rollback triggered by infra issue. otherwise we can close the runbook in 24h.
maria: filing the short post-deploy note to release notes and tagging product.
ops-bot: Audit entry created: audit-5521. Breakglass usage: no. Session expiration: 45m.
alex: thanks everyone. please add any follow-ups below. :thumbsup:
